title: Browser panel — does the open button show the assistant's own browser?

steps.path: Ask the assistant to open any website, then look at the buttons at the top right of the Browser panel
steps.headline: Press the box-and-arrow button. Does the assistant's own browser open as a window, showing the same page?
steps.changed: Before, this button sent the page's address to your own Chrome, which opened it as you, not as the assistant. Now it opens the assistant's browser itself in a window, with its sign-ins and tabs. Hovering says 'Open the browser in its own window'.
steps.notice: First a box asks 'Open the browser window?' and warns that pages reload. After you agree, a separate browser window appears showing the same page. Press the button again (now highlighted) to hide it.
steps.risk: Opening or hiding the window reloads every open page, so anything typed and not yet sent is lost. That's why it asks first. This test window is a second copy of the app; close it when you're done. Your own app is not touched.
